newsitem.title: USA: Fluke to remedy slowing order growth.
newsitem.headline: Fluke to remedy slowing order growth.

text.p: Fluke Corp said on Thursday that it aims to address slowing order growth by expanding its geographic and market segment coverage for its network products.
"While our networking business remains strong, our network product sales were lower than expected in the United States," chairman and chief executive officer Bill Parzybok said in a statement.
Fluke said despite positive signs of continued growth, the company faced "some challenges" that have affected order growth.
The company said it has encountered some difficulty with the U.S. distribution of products acquired from DeskNet Systems and are actively addressing those issues.
Parzybok said, "The steps we are taking are positioning Fluke for long-term growth. We have a strong product introduction schedule planned for the rest of the year."
